text: But the veil was never perfect. It leaks. It begins small. A book falls open to the exact
page you needed. A stranger says the sentence you've been waiting your whole life to hear,
and walks away before you can ask their name. You meditate, or you walk, or you wash dishes,
and for three seconds the noise stops. And underneath it you hear something vast and quiet,
like an ocean heard through a wall. Pay attention to the synchronicities. They are not accidents.
They are the part of you that is still awake, slipping notes under the door. Every impossible
coincidence is a reminder wearing a disguise. And then one day the big one. It is different for
everyone. For some it is a crisis that burns every false thing away. For some it is a love so large
it cracks the shell. For some it is simply sitting still long enough to notice the light that has
been leaking through the cracks all along. When it comes, do not be afraid of how much you remember.
You are not going mad, you are waking up. The stone in deep water is rising, and it has your name
on it. The true one. The one the council called you by.
